- Time Trial mode is another mode that tests your money-making skills over a limited amount of time
In Time Trial Mode, there is no egg piece to buy. Instead, you have to purchase a random egg that contains a random pet. You can keep purchasing random eggs until all your pets are in use. The random egg prices follow a pattern that the initial price will be doubled and that will be the price of the next random egg.The goal of this mode is to earn as much money before time runs out. From the money you earned, 5% will be taken and converted to shells and added to your balance.

- Challenge mode is the most complex mode in the game. The player must fully understand the game in order to beat it.
The goal for this mode is the same as Adventure Mode: to collect three egg pieces to finish the level. However, there are twists to make the average session in this mode harder. Every 4 seconds, each item that is already opened will increase its price by 1% of its starting price. For example, a guppy costs $100. 1% of it is $1. So, it's price will keep increasing by $1. Same goes with every other item. A $200 food quality upgrade will keep increasing its price by $2. A $300 food quantity upgrade will keep increasing its price by $3. Additionally, any item that is still locked after five minutes will automatically be unlocked. Once an egg piece is bought, all items will temporarily stop  increasing in price. Non-egg piece items will additionally reset back to their starting price.

- The Virtual Tank is a mode in game
Starting off, the player is given 200 shells to spend and can earn more through playing Adventure, Time Trial, and Challenge modes and caring for their fish which also drop shells. Virtual Tank fish can never die, but still require at least three daily feedings to keep their mood content; if their mood drops, they may not produce shells until made happy again. Fish in the Virtual Tank take much longer to mature and grow than in other game modes, roughly a week per growth stage with proper care.

In the game you already have a few fish and 200 coins; With this money you have to buy food at 5 VND/pellet for the fish because the fish will die if you starve them. This process takes a certain time, when the fish grows up it will generate money for you if the fish gives birth. For silver coins you can get 5 coins, when the fish gives birth to gold coins you get 15 coins and 50 coins if the fish gives birth to diamonds for you.

Your task is to feed them at the right time, at the right time, to protect them from dangers coming from schools of fierce fish; You must destroy the evil fish otherwise they will eat all your fish.
